governing_law: FEMA and RBI annual FLA reporting requirements
applicability_text: Entities covered by RBI FLA FAQ, including eligible companies/LLPs with outstanding inward/outward direct investment at year end; distinguish special AIF procedure.
deadline_text: 15 July of reporting year. Provisional figures may be used; obtain FLAIR permission to revise as described in current FAQ.
compliance_name: Annual foreign liabilities and assets return
documents: Financial statements; investment/shareholding data; FLAIR verification and authority letters for registration
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Rules 9A/9B
applicability_text: Companies covered by applicable dematerialisation rules; assess unlisted public/private class, exclusions, relevant financial-year status and transition.
deadline_text: Within 60 days of each applicable half-year end; verify period-specific relaxations.
exceptions_text: Do not activate from current turnover alone. Rule 9B transition and changed small-company status need separate legal review.
documents: ISIN and depository balances; issued/listed/physical/demat capital reconciliation; professional certification
process_notes: Do not activate from current turnover alone. Rule 9B transition and changed small-company status need separate legal review.

governing_law: Companies Act section 64; Share Capital and Debentures Rules
applicability_text: Applicable capital alteration, increase/consolidation/division or specified redemption events; purpose controls attachments.
deadline_text: Section 64 ordinarily requires notice within 30 days of alteration/increase/redemption; evaluate exact event.
compliance_name: Notice of alteration of share capital
documents: Resolution; altered memorandum/articles where relevant; capital breakdown; tribunal order where applicable
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Companies Act section 140(2); Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, rule 8
applicability_text: Resigning auditor must file; company workflow should track receipt and replacement separately.
deadline_text: Within 30 days of resignation; additional CAG communication where section 140 applies.
exceptions_text: Legal filer is the auditor, not automatically the company or its director.
documents: Resignation letter; auditor identity and membership/firm details; reasons and relevant facts
process_notes: Legal filer is the auditor, not automatically the company or its director.

governing_law: APEDA Act and current e-RCMC procedure
applicability_text: Exporters of APEDA scheduled agricultural/processed-food products; distinguish merchant and manufacturer category.
deadline_text: Obtain applicable registration for scheduled-product export; certificate validity is five years under current procedure. Confirm exact initial statutory clock.
documents: Signed/sealed IEC; product-specific manufacturing evidence for manufacturer or combined category
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: NITI Aayog Darpan requirements; applicable grant, FCRA and PML records framework
applicability_text: NPOs needing Darpan ID for central grants, relevant FCRA/tax applications or bank account requirements. Separate bank duty from NPO application prerequisites.
deadline_text: Before the relevant application/account process requires the ID; keep registration particulars current.
exceptions_text: Guidance URL; follow NITI current portal link. Do not assume Darpan substitutes for CSR-1 or tax registration.
documents: Entity registration and PAN particulars; governing-body and contact details; current portal checklist
process_notes: Guidance URL; follow NITI current portal link. Do not assume Darpan substitutes for CSR-1 or tax registration.

governing_law: CGST Act section 29 and applicable registration rules
applicability_text: Registered person seeking cancellation on legally permitted grounds; transfers, cessation and exemptions need separate assessment.
deadline_text: Determine event and statutory application period; outstanding obligations survive cancellation where law requires.
exceptions_text: Government entry point supplied; specific cancellation workflow still needs direct procedure verification.
documents: GSTIN; reason and event date; stock/liability particulars; supporting cessation/transfer evidence
process_notes: Government entry point supplied; specific cancellation workflow still needs direct procedure verification.

governing_law: CGST Act section 45; CGST Rules rule 81
applicability_text: Cancelled registrations within section 45 scope. Check taxpayer category and statutory exclusions; not a universal return for every GST registration class.
deadline_text: Within three months of cancellation date or cancellation-order date, whichever is later; applicable extensions require review.
documents: Cancellation order and effective date; stock and capital-goods details; tax liability/payment records
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: LLP Rules rule 37 and applicable amendments
applicability_text: Eligible inactive LLP electing strike-off, after checking liabilities, filings, inactivity period and regulator consent.
deadline_text: Application only after applicable eligibility period; not a recurring annual obligation.
exceptions_text: Execution of declarations and any notarisation remain separate from online submission.
documents: Statement of accounts; partner consent; declarations/affidavits and indemnities as applicable; regulator NOC for regulated activity
process_notes: Execution of declarations and any notarisation remain separate from online submission.

governing_law: Companies Act sections 248/249; Removal of Names Rules
applicability_text: Eligible company electing removal after liabilities and statutory restrictions are addressed.
deadline_text: Event-based; satisfy eligibility and required filings before application.
exceptions_text: Section 8 and regulated-company restrictions require review; candidate entity mapping is not approval of eligibility.
documents: Statement of accounts; member approvals; indemnities/affidavits; liability and litigation disclosures; applicable regulatory approvals
process_notes: Section 8 and regulated-company restrictions require review; candidate entity mapping is not approval of eligibility.

applicability_text: Eligible company electing formal dormant status; simple inactivity does not itself confer approved dormant status.
deadline_text: Optional event-based application after eligibility review.
exceptions_text: Detailed current MSC-1 checklist remains indicative.
documents: Company approvals; activity and financial particulars; required consents/certifications
process_notes: Detailed current MSC-1 checklist remains indicative.

applicability_text: Companies with dormant status subject to prescribed annual return; other event filings may still apply.
deadline_text: Within 30 days of financial-year end; verify current notifications and applicable period.
exceptions_text: Legacy instruction kit supports deadline, not proof every current portal screen is unchanged.
documents: Audited statement of financial position; dormant-status and director particulars; prescribed declarations
process_notes: Legacy instruction kit supports deadline, not proof every current portal screen is unchanged.

applicability_text: Applicant receiving an examination report requiring response.
deadline_text: Respond within one month of receipt under rule 33; actual service and case directions matter.
exceptions_text: Hearings and affidavit requirements are case-specific; online filing is not a no-physical-step guarantee.
documents: Examination report; ground-wise response; relevant use/supporting evidence; agent authorisation as applicable
process_notes: Hearings and affidavit requirements are case-specific; online filing is not a no-physical-step guarantee.

governing_law: Trade Marks Act section 21; Trade Marks Rules 2017 rule 44
applicability_text: Applicant served with opposition and wishing to defend registration; distinguish initiating opposition and later evidence stages.
deadline_text: TM-O counterstatement within two months of receipt of notice copy from Registrar.
documents: Opposition notice and service evidence; counterstatement; applicant/agent authority; subsequent evidence separately required
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

applicability_text: Eligible private company, registered partnership, LLP or cooperative meeting innovation/original-entity and age/turnover conditions; recognition is optional for relevant benefits.
turnover_basis: Normal: no FY since incorporation exceeding INR 200 crore; recognised Deep Tech: INR 300 crore. Separate age and activity tests; tax exemption has distinct eligibility.
deadline_text: Apply while eligible; recognition is distinct from separate tax-benefit approval.
documents: Entity incorporation/registration evidence; innovation/scalability explanation; authorised contact; current supporting documents
process_notes: Filing channel and physical requirements require independent evidence.

governing_law: Companies Act section 252 and applicable NCLT procedure
applicability_text: Eligible applicant pursuing restoration; appeal/application standing and limitation differ.
deadline_text: Case-specific section 252 limitation and tribunal-order compliance; do not assign one deadline to every applicant.
exceptions_text: MCA is the order-filing route; tribunal petition and hearing procedure are separate.
compliance_name: Restoration of struck-off company / order filing
documents: Petition and supporting records; NCLT order; proof of costs/compliance; current ROC filings as directed
process_notes: MCA is the order-filing route; tribunal petition and hearing procedure are separate.
